description: The state of a house request or house by its ticket id: requested, confirmed, expired, declined; later building, trial, licensed, dormant, exported, deleted. Says what to do next, and the address once the house exists. Ask no more than once an hour.

ticket_id.description: The ticket id returned by request_house.

name: house_status

address.description: The address of the house once it exists. Null before.

id.description: The ticket id; pass it to house_status.

state.description: One of: requested (waits for the person's click), confirmed (the person clicked), expired (not confirmed in time), declined (the person said no); later: building, trial, licensed, dormant, exported, deleted.

title: Status of a house request
